description: Move a note to Recently Deleted. The first call returns a confirmToken; call again with it (or confirm=true where the policy allows the tool) to delete. Recoverable from Recently Deleted for 30 days.

confirmToken.description: The confirmToken from a confirmation_required error, sent with the same arguments.

dryRun.description: Report what the call would do without doing it.

idempotencyKey.description: A repeat of this key and arguments within 24 hours replays the first result.
